title: Safe and Sound
lyrics:
[Intro]
Bank break got the loot now run, run, run! go go go!
Safe and sound
Sirens, police chatter, 808, Safe and Sound, Unit 48 — all good

[Verse 1]
Acid adrenalin pumping
Heart bass drum stomping
Conductor Mind
Next move to find
Guard got up, spin and drop
Roll upside down without a frown
As that clown will take you down
Driver ready, hands steady
Mirror eyes, here’s my guys!

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Hit the street like it was all last week
City flashes by, I heard a siren cry
Drive, driver, drive!

[Verse 2]
Watch out, Pig Truck!
Driver drifts then push
No bacon tonight
Pigs safe and sound
Big black hearse truck
Means only one thing
Rest in peace, no releases
Sirens blare, drive no care
Cops are here, pigs I care

[Bridge]
Driver spins, no pig skin
Big black truck, driver takes the tyre out
Pigs freed, safe and sound
Cops on the back, driver stop!
The driver drifts, sneaky sneaky
Phonk 808 slides, Panthera pounce
Shades the move, pork little piggies almost got smacked
On the G4 delta Track

[Verse 3]
Bumble Bee bytes
Bits and bits of bytes
Flying paths right
Driver eyes, eyes of the night
Round and round, almost upside down
We did 360, spin around
Reverse, reverse, reverse
3 mirrors and they’re in front
Driver’s viral stunts, safe and sound
Math driver has us, safe and sound

[Outro]
Driver got us home
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
